% PGF decorations.text: reverse the scanned character boxes along a path.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.text}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] (0,-0.5) grid (6,1.5);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,1) -- (6,1);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text effects along path,text={normal text},text align={center},raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,characters={text along path}}]
    (0,1) -- (6,1);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,0) -- (6,0);
  \path[decorate,text effects={reverse text},decoration={text effects along path,text={normal text},text align={center},raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,characters={text along path}}]
    (0,0) -- (6,0);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
